tests.label: engine.test.js
tests.stdout: Branch Wars engine tests passed: 48 long-run campaigns plus open-ended endings, capability, validation, migration, rematch, AI-coverage, direct-link session, UI contract and generated-reference checks.

tests.label: accounting.test.js
tests.stdout: Accounting prototype tests passed: opening reconciliation, atomic postings, transfers, loan funding, retained profits, noncash losses, debt, securities sales, 27 real previews and 2000 reconciled stress postings. Campaign rules remain unchanged.

tests.label: accounting_activities.test.js
tests.stdout: Accounting activity tests passed: expense/capital classification, 24 live opportunity rewards, 20 live acquisition comparisons, two-sided settlements, debt conservation, penalties, franchise funding and atomic batches. Campaign economy remains v1/v2.

tests.label: accounting_persistence.test.js
tests.stdout: Accounting persistence tests passed: 256-entry snapshots, checkpoint reconciliation, exact continuation, repeated pruning, 15 corruptions, invalid histories and no campaign migration.

tests.label: bank_identity.test.js
tests.stdout: Bank identity tests passed: picker wiring, seat perspectives, save migration, rematches, legacy defaults, unsafe values, matching colors, handshake contracts and simulation neutrality.
